# ethereum-optimism/infra Daily Update (Feb 11, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day saw significant progress in consolidating Rust-based projects within the monorepo, with several issues related to `op-reth` and Rust workspace unification being closed. Discussions continued on Kona hint serialization and L2CM risk modeling.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

No new features, bug fixes, code refactoring, documentation enhancements, tests added, or other work were completed today.

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
No new pull requests were opened today.

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Rust Monorepo Integration
Several issues related to the integration and consolidation of Rust projects within the monorepo were closed. This includes the removal of the `reth` submodule and updating CI to use `op-reth` [#18919](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/18919), the unification of all Rust crates into a single workspace [#18930](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/18930), and the consolidation of zepter configurations across Rust repositories [#18931](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/18931).

### op-reth Documentation Porting
The task of porting documentation from `reth` to `op-reth` was completed [#18969](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/18969).

### op-reth Snapshot Setup
The issue concerning the `op-reth` snapshot setup was closed [#536](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/536).

## NEW ISSUES

### Devfeatures Cyclic Dependency
A new issue was opened to address a cyclic dependency in `op-deployer` where development feature flags are hardcoded as hex values in multiple places, despite a source of truth existing in `op-deployer/pkg/deployer/devfeatures.go` [#19151](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19151).

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Kona Hint Serialization
Discussion continued on the proposal to use a binary format for Kona hints instead of string serialization [#19125](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19125). @ajsutton expressed skepticism about the necessity of this change, questioning the performance benefits and highlighting the backward compatibility requirements for the host. @kien-rise clarified that the primary motivation is "making things right" rather than speed, but anticipates performance improvements. They also offered to propose an approach that preserves compatibility.

### L2CM Upgrades Risk Modeling
@maurelian provided templates for performing risk modeling (FMA or threat model) for the L2CM design, referencing existing FMA documents for OPCMv2 [#18869](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/18869).

### Kona Outdated Just Recipes
@Inphi commented that the custom `just` recipes for building `kona-host/client` are still needed as they are convenient for developers during local testing, despite the monorepo now being used to build the prestate [#18654](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/18654). This suggests a need to retain these recipes even after the monorepo migration.
